bio: Its Belle Epoque style lends this restaurant on the first floor of the Grand Casino a distinct elegance and charm that hark back to a bygone era. Under a high ceiling with moulding and chandeliers, Mediterranean-inspired cuisine is served in the form of a set menu or à la carte. The Dinner & Casino packages are also worth mentioning. Fabulous balcony terrace with lake and mountain views. Tip: Park in the casino garage....
